title: Performance & Optimization
description: Optimize React Query performance with selective fetching, windowing, and memoization patterns.
longDescription: This module covers performance optimization techniques for React Query applications. You will learn selective fetching to avoid over-fetching, windowing strategies for large lists, memoization of query results, reducing unnecessary re-renders, and profiling React Query performance with DevTools. Each technique is grounded in real-world scenarios where unoptimized React Query usage leads to sluggish UIs, wasted bandwidth, and poor user experience on low-end devices.
whatYouLearn: Implement selective fetching to reduce unnecessary network requests
Use windowing techniques for rendering large datasets efficiently
Apply memoization to prevent redundant query executions
Profile and debug React Query performance with DevTools
Combine react-window or react-virtuoso with useInfiniteQuery
Use React DevTools Profiler to identify unnecessary re-renders
